description: Use this when someone asks how much it costs to rent a MERA RENT robot on a given date, for a number of hours, in a city. MERA never gives amounts outside its app, so this returns no amount: it returns the MERA RENT link that shows the exact price for that robot, date, hours (up to 2, 4 or 8 h per day) and country, what the price includes (operator, travel in Europe, conversations in more than 70 languages), the payment rule (100% before the event), the calendar status of the date and the arguments for start_booking. Never state or estimate a price yourself.

country.description: Country of the event: ISO 3166 code ("PT") or name in any language.

hours.description: Robot time on site per day: up to 2, 4 or 8 hours (the app prices these packages).

lang.description: Language the person writes in (ISO 639, e.g. "en", "de", "pl"). The MERA RENT app has 24 languages; others get English.

robot.description: Robot id from MERA RENT, e.g. "g1" (Unitree G1), "h2" (Unitree H2), "go2" (Unitree Go2), "edward" (Edward Warchocki) or a catalog model such as "unitree-h1"; start_booking without a robot lists them.

name: get_rental_quote
title: MERA RENT: price for a robot on a date
